title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai

thread.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day • Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai - Episode 13 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Several viewers considered the finale emotionally effective and praised its handling of the characters’ inner struggles.
The cast, especially Ari, received warm reactions, with viewers finding the character-focused material compelling.
Some commenters rated the series very highly overall and expressed strong interest in a second season.
The episode’s narrow focus and subdued finale structure worked for some viewers but felt unexpectedly limited or OVA-like to others.
Viewers appreciated the conclusion while also feeling that major worldbuilding and story questions remained unresolved.
Many comments criticized Crunchyroll for releasing the finale without English subtitles on time.
